mechanism_chain: sustained antecedent rainfall and very high event-day point rainfall
hillside failure on mountainous terrain above flood-filled stream valleys
mud, boulders, and tree debris travelled at least 3 km toward the coast
deforestation and rapid city expansion increased exposure in landslide-prone terrain
cloud-limited optical imagery made radar change evidence operationally important

assumption_changes: period rainfall anomaly increases to 3.6 times normal
dense forest remaining decreases to 45 km2
population and mapped exposure features used in response load +20 percent

response_priorities: Stabilize evacuation and search operations along flood-filled stream valleys and the mapped runout path.
Protect schools, hospitals, police posts, shelters, and major road links inside the populated AOI.
Prioritize radar-based change assessment because cloud and zero usable optical scenes constrain optical mapping.
primary_gt.final_interpretation: The package supports a severe compound landslide response-load state: exceptional rainfall loaded a deforested, urbanizing hillslope system, produced long valley runout into exposed communities, and remains highly sensitive to wetter and more exposed future wet-season conditions.

index_formulas.rainfall_trigger_index: Weighted normalized point rainfall, regional rainfall, period anomaly, and event-day period share.
index_formulas.hillslope_runout_index: Weighted normalized topographic failure evidence, runout, forest loss, city growth, and valley flood coupling.
index_formulas.observability_constraint_index: Weighted radar balance, radar signal magnitude, cloud fraction, and optical gap.
index_formulas.response_load_index: Weighted population, critical facilities, schools, major roads, waterways, and reported impact severity.

rainfall.event_day_point_selection: maximum available point rainfall sample used as upper-bound trigger stress value

criteria.name: Self-directed package discovery and source citation
criteria.description: Identifies the relevant report, hazard, exposure, geospatial, and remote-sensing package files without being given filenames and cites package-relative paths.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if citations are incomplete but at least three evidence families are represented.

criteria.name: Rainfall loading and event-window extraction
criteria.description: Extracts the 2017-08-14 window, reports the point-rainfall source range and upper-bound selection rule, computes regional and multi-sensor rainfall, period anomaly, event-day share, and rainfall_trigger_index.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct rainfall values with one formula or rounding error.

criteria.name: Hillslope, runout, deforestation, and AOI geometry
criteria.description: Uses report language for failure mechanics, computes runout, forest loss, city growth, AOI short-side normalization, and hillslope_runout_index.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 2-3 points for mostly correct values with one missing process component; award 1 point for only forest loss or runout.

criteria.name: Remote-sensing observability reasoning
criteria.description: Combines radar scene balance, radar mean change, change-to-std ratio, optical scene gap, cloud fraction, and observability_constraint_index.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if radar values are correct but optical/cloud interpretation is weak.

criteria.name: Emergency response-load metrics
criteria.description: Counts critical facilities, schools, major roads, waterways, population, deaths, displaced people, damage, and computes response_load_index.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points for correct exposure counts with incomplete impact normalization.

criteria.name: Compound and scenario calculations
criteria.description: Computes compound_process_index, risk_state, all future stress scenario indices, and compound_delta with correct clipping and weights.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 1-2 points if the baseline compound index is correct but scenario arithmetic has a small error.

criteria.name: Disaster-process interpretation and priorities
criteria.description: Provides three ordered response priorities and a concise interpretation tied to rainfall, runout, observability, and exposed assets.
criteria.partial_credit: Award 0.5 points if priorities are plausible but not anchored in computed metrics.
